intermediateFailure.cause: The new measurement ACTIVITY fixture omitted its mandatory exercise/rubric; publication correctly rejected it with CONTENT_NOT_READY. Fixture completed, no production validation or assertion weakened.

inputLimits.scope: SHA-256(namespace + existing CSRF session ID); no raw session ID, email or IP stored as key
inputLimits.transaction: Independent REQUIRES_NEW counter transaction commits before authentication/password hashing. Failed authentication and duplicate registration still consume a counted attempt.
inputLimits.filter: After CsrfFilter; invalid CSRF remains403 without consuming quota.
inputLimits.response: 429 RATE_LIMITED, private/no-store, integer Retry-After >=1; separate session and expired window allow normal resumption.
limits: A new session starts a new quota; this is not a global anti-bot, distributed rate-limiting or account-lockout guarantee.
Existing neutral password reset email limit remains unchanged.
No new data retention policy, operational deletion job or new schema is introduced.

reusedBoundaries.search: Parameterized query, q <=240 characters, pageSize <=100, deterministic pagination; existing actual HTTP test rerun.
reusedBoundaries.email: Existing atomic known/unknown account password-reset quota test rerun, with neutral HTTP flow covered by HTTPAuthIntegrationTest.
reusedBoundaries.uploads: Existing real S3/PostgreSQL concurrent reservation quota and size/MIME/UTF-8 validation tests rerun; no antivirus or PDF validation claimed.

accessFollowUp.policy: The same canonical CTE is used for single and batched entitlement checks; owner/locale/version/origin/period and full published ancestry predicates are retained.
accessFollowUp.diagnostics: Seven existing refund positive expectations keep one covers read followed by failure-only minimized facts. Fresh origin test keeps negative pre-grant controls and16 parallel member/activity FR/EN GETs after a PG -> Instant -> Timestamp commit; no grant date margin/retry. Failure-only facts now include unexpected status, access state or absent private document. Diagnostic failure cannot replace the original assertion.
accessFollowUp.boundary: A successful selected run does not establish a cause or close the historical incidents. Any unexpected refusal stops the path; collect facts before cleanup, suspend delivery and investigate.

limits: Targeted passes are separate executions; the repeated fresh-origin case is not an additional distinct test.
No browser, accessibility certification, external Stripe, deployment or overall phase validation is claimed by this API report.
Only the first3 page sizes and1/10/100-activity local fixtures were measured; timings are observations, not visitor percentiles or a full-scale capacity test.
serviceMeasurementScope: Real service JdbcTemplate executions and elapsed call time only; HTTP authentication/session repository, fixture setup and serialization are not counted. Response JSON bytes measured separately; equal sizes do not establish content identity.
